currentObjective: Create a compilable and packable scaffold for the isolated ComplexityAnalysis.Analyzers project without analyzer implementation code.
decisions: The analyzer project remains isolated at analyzer/src/ComplexityAnalysis.Analyzers/.
The project targets netstandard2.0 and sets IsAnalyzerProject=true, IsPackable=true, EnforceExtendedAnalyzerRules=true, and Nullable=enable.
Central Package Management is used from analyzer/Directory.Packages.props; project PackageReference items do not declare Version.
Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp remains pinned to 4.8.0 and Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Analyzers to 3.3.4.
Packaging uses IncludeBuildOutput=false, SuppressDependenciesWhenPacking=true, DevelopmentDependency=true, and explicitly packs the built DLL into analyzers/dotnet/cs/.
No DiagnosticAnalyzer, diagnostic descriptor, BIG9000 probe, syntax analysis, semantic analysis, CodeFixProvider, or copied inherited classes were added in this step.
constraints: Do not add ProjectReference or dependency on inherited projects.
Do not modify inherited projects outside analyzer/.
Do not add Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Workspaces or Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Workspaces in Phase 1.
Do not add MathNet.Numerics in Phase 1.
Do not implement Big-O analysis, BIG9000, DiagnosticAnalyzer, DiagnosticDescriptor, syntax analysis, semantic analysis, loop analysis, BCL mappings, or CodeFixProvider during step 2/5.
Package the analyzer assembly under analyzers/dotnet/cs/ and avoid lib/netstandard2.0/ for the analyzer assembly.

dotnet build --configuration Release --no-restore succeeded in analyzer/.
The nupkg contains analyzers/dotnet/cs/ComplexityAnalysis.Analyzers.dll and does not contain lib/netstandard2.0/ComplexityAnalysis.Analyzers.dll.

The analyzer project contains no ProjectReference, Workspaces package, MathNet.Numerics package, or Version attribute on PackageReference items.
Only analyzer/handoff/phase-1.json and analyzer/src/ComplexityAnalysis.Analyzers/ComplexityAnalysis.Analyzers.csproj changed before commit.
